scope: corpus-scale App Store availability for the Chinese storefront and the category composition of what is removed
relationship: complements the app-storefront signal, which is our own live panel and detects individual delisting events; this is scale and composition, and does not feed that signal's rate

control.why: 175 country rows; 109308 apps tested for CN

reading: 28.1% of 109,308 tested apps are unavailable in the China mainland App Store, 1 of 175 surveyed storefronts
composition_reading: removals are tagged VPN 110, Religion and Cultures 18, Tibet 16, News Media and Information 13 — the ordering is what the removals are for, not merely how many
